description: Public OTLP authentication provider throttling or outages. Inspect the MoltNet Metrics dashboard, separate 429 from unavailable outcomes, and verify Hydra/Talos/Kratos health before changing rate limits.
disabledReason: The custom public-OTLP Collector is not deployed by this repository and moltnet.auth.provider.requests is absent from Axiom.
mplQuery:
`moltnet-metrics`:`moltnet.auth.provider.requests`
| where `outcome` == "rate_limited" or `outcome` == "unavailable"
| align to 1m using prom::rate
| group by `operation`, `outcome` using sum
name: MoltNet public OTLP auth provider failures
